sources.title: Whois Lookup Tool - Check Domain registration info - MxToolbox
sources.snippet: ABOUT WHOIS LOOKUP This test will return WHOIS registration results for a DOMAIN name. Depending on the registrar, you can see various information like who is it registered to, when it was registered and when it expires, where the DNS is hosted, and more. In some cases, you will be able to go the registrar's site to get more information.
